name: apple-reminders
description: Access Apple Reminders on macOS via EventKit — search, create, update, complete, and delete reminders with full support for subtasks, recurrence, alarms, and locations.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Apple Reminders on your Mac via Apple's first-class EventKit framework. Full read+write coverage of the Reminders data model.

**Features:**
- Browse all reminder lists across all accounts (iCloud, Local, CalDAV, Exchange)
- Search reminders by free text, list, completion, due date, priority
- Create reminders with notes, URL, due/start dates, and priority
- Recurrence rules — daily/weekly/monthly/yearly, with intervals, by-day/by-month, end date or count
- Alarms — relative offset, absolute date, or location-based geofence (enter/leave)
- Subtasks — create child reminders, list children, cascade delete
- Mark reminders complete or uncomplete
- Manage reminder lists themselves — create, rename, recolor, delete
- Deep-link any reminder via x-apple-reminderkit:// URL
- Read AND write real Apple Reminders tags — the chips shown in Reminders.app — add, remove, replace, and filter by them

**Requirements:**
- macOS 14 Sonoma or later
- Reminders permission (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Reminders)
- Full Disk Access, for reading real tags only (everything else works without it)

**Note on tags:** Apple exposes no API for Reminders tags. Reading them means reading the Reminders app's own database; writing them uses Apple's private ReminderKit framework. Both are documented in the README, and tag writing may break on a future macOS release — it will say so plainly rather than fail silently.

tools.name: list_reminder_lists
tools.description: List every reminder list (calendar) on this Mac, with id, title, color, source, and write-access flag

tools.name: create_reminder_list
tools.description: Create a new reminder list with optional color and source/account

tools.name: update_reminder_list
tools.description: Rename or recolor an existing reminder list

tools.name: delete_reminder_list
tools.description: Delete a reminder list and all its reminders (destructive)

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Aggregate counts: list count, total reminders, incomplete, completed, overdue, due today

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List reminders in one or more lists, with filters: completed, priority, due_before/after, has_subtasks, text, tags

tools.name: search_reminders
tools.description: Free-text search across reminder titles and notes, with filters for list, completion, priority, due date, and tags

tools.name: get_reminder
tools.description: Full detail for a reminder — notes, URL, recurrence, alarms, location, subtask ids, real tags, timestamps

tools.name: get_reminder_link
tools.description: Get an x-apple-reminderkit:// URL that opens the reminder in Reminders.app

tools.name: list_subtasks
tools.description: List the immediate subtasks (child reminders) of a parent reminder

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List every real Apple Reminders tag with the number of reminders using it

tools.name: add_reminder_tags
tools.description: Add real Apple tags to a reminder (creates tags that do not exist yet; idempotent)

tools.name: remove_reminder_tags
tools.description: Remove real Apple tags from a reminder

tools.name: set_reminder_tags
tools.description: Replace a reminder's real Apple tags with exactly the given set; empty list clears them

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder with full property set: notes, URL, due/start dates, priority, recurrence, alarms, location, parent (for subtasks), real tags

tools.name: update_reminder
tools.description: Update any subset of a reminder's properties; explicit clear_* flags remove fields

tools.name: complete_reminder
tools.description: Mark a reminder as complete or uncomplete (or toggle if completed is null)

tools.name: delete_reminder
tools.description: Delete a reminder; cascades to subtasks by default
